from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,difflib
root=Path('products/sites/parser-parity-review')
review=Path('products/reviews/parser-parity-llms-final.json').read_text()
readme=(root/'README.md').read_text()
index=(root/'index.html').read_text()
print('REVIEW\n'+review)
assert 'leap' in readme.lower() and '5.6' in readme and 'Appendix A' in readme
assert 'leap' in index.lower()
files={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!='llms.txt'}
p=root/'llms.txt'
old=p.read_text()
needle='Rejecting second 60 and T24:00 is a stated policy choice following RFC 3339 section 5.6.'
replacement='RFC 3339 section 5.6 permits leap seconds under its stated conditions; this demonstration rejects second 60 as an application policy. Section 5.6 restricts hours to 00-23, so T24:00 is rejected. Appendix A is informative and does not replace section 5.6.'
assert old.count(needle)==1, 'Expected original wording absent; stop for inspection'
new=old.replace(needle,replacement)
p.write_text(new)
after={q.name:hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for q in root.iterdir() if q.is_file() and q.name!='llms.txt'}
checks={'six_existing_files':len(files)==6,'existing_files_unchanged':files==after,'only_expected_replacement':new.replace(replacement,needle)==old,'application_policy_explicit':'as an application policy' in new,'informative_appendix_explicit':'Appendix A is informative' in new}
assert all(checks.values()),checks
out=Path('products/distribution/parser-parity-agent-discovery/spec-correction')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'llms.diff').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True),new.splitlines(True),fromfile='llms.txt.before',tofile='llms.txt.after')))
result={'checks':checks,'unchanged_hashes':after,'llms_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'limitations':'Scoped documentation correction only; unchanged parser tests not rerun. Not deployed. No acquisition, demand or revenue established.'}
(out/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print((out/'llms.diff').read_text())
print((out/'checks.json').read_text())
print('CORRECTED COMPLETE DOCUMENT\n'+p.read_text())
